items.comments: We were in Seattle for our son's wedding and the house was perfect for us.  There were 6 adults and 2 children and we had plenty of room.  The house  had a warm, cozy feeling and we felt right at home.  So much better than hotel rooms!  The house was convenient to the wedding venue and we loved the ability to walk around the lovely neighborhood, and to the University.

Great house in a neighborhood filled with beautiful old craftsman style homes.  The fire place and heated floors in the bathroom were a great touch for a cold Seattle week.  Loved the kitchen as well.  Would stay again!
